[ASSISTANT_SAID] A web portal is a website or intranet that serves as a single gateway to a wide range of resources and/or services, typically focused on a particular domain or community.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is designed to provide easy access to information, tools, and services related to a specific topic or group of users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A web portal usually has an active audience that can contribute to its development by visiting, registering, and returning to the portal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Users can find and share information, communicate with other members, and personalize their access to the portal.
